svg.text: A key is saved on this device, and Cloud Suggestions is off, so every suggestion
is produced here, offline. Nothing has been sent anywhere.
Stored only in this browser, and never written into the project. Saving a key does not
turn Cloud Suggestions on — that is the next control, and it is yours to switch.
Turning this on sends your task text to the Anthropic API, using the key above.
The key is yours and there is no server of ours in between.
If the Model Engine fails, is slow, or is refused, the Rule Engine answers instead — with
no message in capture or review.
This screen is the only place the app ever says anything about an engine.
No popup, banner or badge appears in capture or review, ever.
Both produce the same three parts, in the same
purple layer, with the same per-part review.
Whichever answered is printed on the suggestion,
as a word and as a mark.
